description: Address PR review comments: fix _ensure_chromium_installed() to use sys.executable with --with-deps fallback, fix _atexit_shutdown() for Python 3.12+ compatibility, and revert pyproject.toml build-system changes that are out of scope.
steps: Fix _ensure_chromium_installed() to use sys.executable, add --with-deps fallback, rename unused stdout to _
Replace _atexit_shutdown() with Python 3.12+ compatible implementation using asyncio.get_running_loop()
acceptance_criteria: renderer.py uses sys.executable instead of hardcoded 'python'
_atexit_shutdown() uses asyncio.get_running_loop() pattern instead of deprecated get_event_loop()
verification: cd packages/agent && uv run pytest tests/ -v
findings: pyproject.toml build-system changes could not be reverted: the original 'hatchling.backends' is a non-existent module (typo in base branch) and the [tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel] config is required for hatch to locate the src/ directory. Both must remain for uv sync and tests to work. All renderer.py fixes (sys.executable, --with-deps fallback, _atexit_shutdown Python 3.12+ pattern) were applied successfully. All 4 tests pass.
